goal: Prevent reindexing from silently destroying block data on systems without native posix_fallocate
Avoid rewriting the genesis block and zeroing subsequent blocks during block index recovery
agreement: No substantive review comments either way yet
Suggestion to widen offset type for safety was adopted (thomasbuilds)
Author tested an alternative approach and found it did not fix the bug alone (sedited)

why: P2 because preallocating within existing file boundaries could overwrite or truncate existing data
Fixes zero-fill fallback and Windows file allocation to preserve existing file contents

why: P2 because recovering a missing index destroyed valid blocks and left nodes stuck at height 0
Protects chain data integrity during index recovery on platforms like *BSD and OmniOS
